description: Source-derived system, registration and staking user transition guard controls; no native credit.

mutants.name: check_system: "wrong native system transaction"
mutants.original: require(row["type"] == 0 and row["from"].lower() == VALIDATOR and q(row["gas_price"]) == 0, "wrong native system transaction")

mutants.name: check_system: "system nonce transition"
mutants.original: require(after[VALIDATOR]["nonce"] == before[VALIDATOR]["nonce"] + 1 and row["nonce"] == before[VALIDATOR]["nonce"], "system nonce transition")

mutants.name: check_system: "system sender balance"
mutants.original: require(balance(after, VALIDATOR) == balance(before, VALIDATOR) - value, "system sender balance")

mutants.name: check_system: "failed system transaction"
mutants.original: require(q(row["receipt"]["status"]) == 1 and row["error"] is None, "failed system transaction")

mutants.name: check_system: "wrong initializer"
mutants.original: require(to in expected and value == 0, "wrong initializer")

mutants.name: check_system: "initializer packed state"
mutants.original: require(slot(before, to, "0") == 0 and slot(after, to, "0") == packed, "initializer packed state")

mutants.name: check_system: "initializer selected storage: " + key
mutants.original: require(slot(before, to, key) == 0 and slot(after, to, key) == value, "initializer selected storage: " + key)

mutants.name: check_system: "initializer moved funds"
mutants.original: require(balance(before, address) == balance(after, address), "initializer moved funds")

mutants.name: check_system: "wrong deposit input"
mutants.original: require(to == VALIDATOR_CONTRACT and value > 0 and row["data"][8:] == VALIDATOR[2:].zfill(64), "wrong deposit input")

mutants.name: check_system: "deposit preconditions"
mutants.original: require(slot(before, to, "0") == 1 and slot(before, to, "23") == slot(before, to, "24") == 0, "deposit preconditions")

mutants.name: check_system: "deposit ratios"
mutants.original: require(slot(after, to, "6") == 1000 and slot(after, to, "15") == 625 and slot(after, to, "20") == 1, "deposit ratios")

mutants.name: check_system: "deposit distribution"
mutants.original:
require(balance(after, to) - balance(before, to) == remaining and balance(after, REWARD) - balance(before, REWARD) == reward and
                balance(after, BURN) - balance(before, BURN) == burn, "deposit distribution")

mutants.name: check_system: "deposit validator mapping"
mutants.original: require(index in (0, 1) and slot(after, to, "validator_index") == index, "deposit validator mapping")

mutants.name: check_system: "deposit active income"
mutants.original:
require(slot(after, to, "3") - slot(before, to, "3") == delta and
                slot(after, to, "first_validator_incoming") - slot(before, to, "first_validator_incoming") == delta,
                "deposit active income")

mutants.name: check_system: "wrong election input"
mutants.original: require(to == VALIDATOR_CONTRACT and value == 0, "wrong election input")

mutants.name: check_system: "election did not install owned validator"
mutants.original:
require(slot(before, to, "validator_index") == 0 and slot(after, to, "validator_index") == 1 and
                slot(after, to, "1") == 1 and slot(after, to, "3") == slot(after, to, "first_validator_incoming") == 0,
                "election did not install owned validator")
mutants.replacement: require(True, "election did not install owned validator")

mutants.name: check_system: "election dusk transfer"
mutants.original: require(balance(after, to) == 0 and balance(after, REWARD) - balance(before, REWARD) == balance(before, to), "election dusk transfer")

mutants.name: check_registration_input: "wrong registration envelope"
mutants.original:
require(q(fields["chainId"]) == 714 and q(fields["gas"]) == 8000000 and q(fields["gasPrice"]) == 2000000000,
            "wrong registration envelope")

mutants.name: check_registration_input: "wrong registration ABI size/selector"
mutants.original: require(data[:4].hex() == REGISTER and len(data) == 772, "wrong registration ABI size/selector")

mutants.name: check_registration_input: "wrong registration ABI head"
mutants.original:
require(word(0) == int(VALIDATOR, 16) and [word(i * 32) for i in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)] == [224, 320, 100, 1000, 100, 448],
            "wrong registration ABI head")

mutants.name: check_registration_input: "wrong registration vote bytes"
mutants.original: require(word(224) == 48 and args[256:304] == vote and args[304:320] == bytes(16), "wrong registration vote bytes")

mutants.name: check_registration_input: "wrong registration proof bytes"
mutants.original: require(word(320) == 96 and args[352:448] != bytes(96), "wrong registration proof bytes")

mutants.name: check_registration_input: "wrong registration description offsets"
mutants.original: require([word(448 + i * 32) for i in range(4)] == [128, 192, 224, 256], "wrong registration description offsets")

mutants.name: check_registration_input: "wrong registration description"
mutants.original:
require(word(offset) == len(expected) and args[offset + 32:offset + 32 + width] == expected.ljust(width, b"\0"),
                "wrong registration description")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "wrong bootstrap sender context"
mutants.original: require(row["type"] == 0 and row["to"].lower() == STAKE_HUB and row["nonce"] == (2 if restore else 1), "wrong bootstrap sender context")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "wrong bootstrap envelope"
mutants.original: require(q(fields["chainId"]) == 714 and q(fields["gas"]) == 2000000 and q(fields["gasPrice"]) == 2000000000, "wrong bootstrap envelope")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "wrong bootstrap ABI"
mutants.original: require(row["data"] == expected, "wrong bootstrap ABI")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "validator extras not initialized"
mutants.original:
require(slot(before, VALIDATOR_CONTRACT, "11") == (21 if restore else 0) and slot(after, VALIDATOR_CONTRACT, "11") == 21,
            "validator extras not initialized")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "pending unbond native funds"
mutants.original:
require(balance(before, CREDIT) == 2001 * 10**18 and balance(after, CREDIT) == (2002 if restore else 2001) * 10**18,
            "pending unbond native funds")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "bootstrap changed validator membership"
mutants.original:
require(slot(state, VALIDATOR_CONTRACT, "validator_index") == 0 and slot(state, VALIDATOR_CONTRACT, "1") == 21,
                "bootstrap changed validator membership")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "bootstrap jailed only validator"
mutants.original: require(slot(state, STAKE_HUB, "validator_jail_until") == 0 and slot(state, STAKE_HUB, "73") == 0, "bootstrap jailed only validator")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "unexpected unbond period"
mutants.original: require(slot(state, STAKE_HUB, "57") == 604800, "unexpected unbond period")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "bootstrap credit shares"
mutants.original:
require(slot(state, CREDIT, "operator_shares") == own * 10**18 and slot(state, CREDIT, "locked_shares") == 10**18,
                "bootstrap credit shares")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "bootstrap governance sync"
mutants.original:
require(slot(state, gov, "gov_supply") == own * 10**18 and slot(state, gov, "gov_operator") == own * 10**18 and slot(state, gov, "gov_dead") == 0,
                "bootstrap governance sync")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "pending unbond field: " + key
mutants.original: require(slot(before, CREDIT, key) == (value if restore else 0) and slot(after, CREDIT, key) == value, "pending unbond field: " + key)

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "delegate changed pending unlock"
mutants.original:
require(slot(before, CREDIT, "unbond_unlock") == slot(after, CREDIT, "unbond_unlock") and
                row["time"] < slot(after, CREDIT, "unbond_unlock"), "delegate changed pending unlock")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "wrong unbond unlock time"
mutants.original:
require(slot(before, CREDIT, "unbond_unlock") == 0 and slot(after, CREDIT, "unbond_unlock") == row["time"] + 604800,
                "wrong unbond unlock time")

mutants.name: check_bootstrap: "bootstrap credit pool/supply"
mutants.original: require(slot(state, CREDIT, key) == pooled * 10**18, "bootstrap credit pool/supply")

mutants.name: check_user: "user sender/nonce transition"
mutants.original:
require(row["from"].lower() == SENDER and row["nonce"] == index and before[SENDER]["nonce"] == index and after[SENDER]["nonce"] == index + 1,
            "user sender/nonce transition")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong effective fee"
mutants.original: require(q(row["gas_price"]) == price, "wrong effective fee")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong user status"
mutants.original: require(q(receipt["status"]) == status and row["error"] is None, "wrong user status")

mutants.name: check_user: "user fee/value accounting"
mutants.original: require(q(row["value"]) == value and balance(before, SENDER) - balance(after, SENDER) == fee + status * value, "user fee/value accounting")

mutants.name: check_user: "system fee accumulation"
mutants.original: require(balance(after, SYSTEM) - balance(before, SYSTEM) == fee, "system fee accumulation")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong current type row"
mutants.original: require(phase in ("success", "revert") and kind == (index - 3) % 5 and row["time"] >= GENESIS_TIME + 6, "wrong current type row")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong source fields"
mutants.original: require(row["to"].lower() == recipient and q(fields["chainId"]) == 714 and q(fields["gas"]) == 150000 and fields["input"] == "0x", "wrong source fields")

mutants.name: check_user: "user target value"
mutants.original: require(balance(after, recipient) - balance(before, recipient) == status, "user target value")

mutants.name: check_user: "reverted storage survived"
mutants.original: require(slot(after, REVERT, "0") == 0, "reverted storage survived")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong blob fees"
mutants.original: require(q(receipt["blobGasUsed"]) == 131072 and q(receipt["blobGasPrice"]) == 1, "wrong blob fees")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong registration"
mutants.original: require(kind == 0 and row["to"].lower() == STAKE_HUB and value == 2001 * 10**18, "wrong registration")

mutants.name: check_user: "credit CREATE nonce differs"
mutants.original:
require(before[STAKE_HUB]["nonce"] == 0 and after[STAKE_HUB]["nonce"] == 1 and before[CREDIT]["nonce"] == 0 and
                after[CREDIT]["nonce"] == 1, "credit CREATE nonce differs")

mutants.name: check_user: "registration fund movement differs"
mutants.original:
require(balance(before, CREDIT) == 0 and balance(after, CREDIT) == value and balance(before, STAKE_HUB) == balance(after, STAKE_HUB) == 0 and
                balance(before, BURN) == balance(after, BURN), "registration fund movement differs")

mutants.name: check_user: "registration governance dead balance"
mutants.original: require(slot(after, gov, "gov_dead") == 0, "registration governance dead balance")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong gasPrice"
mutants.original: require(q(fields["gasPrice"]) == 2000000000, "wrong gasPrice")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong fee caps"
mutants.original: require(q(fields["maxFeePerGas"]) == 2000000000 and q(fields["maxPriorityFeePerGas"]) == 1000000000, "wrong fee caps")

mutants.name: check_user: "access list order differs"
mutants.original: require(fields["accessList"] == [{"address": target, "storageKeys": ["0x" + "0" * 64] * 2}, {"address": target, "storageKeys": []}], "access list order differs")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong blob input"
mutants.original: require(fields["blobVersionedHashes"] == [expected_hash] and q(fields["maxFeePerBlobGas"]) == 1000000000, "wrong blob input")

mutants.name: check_user: "successful storage missing"
mutants.original: require(slot(after, recipient, "0") == 1, "successful storage missing")

mutants.name: check_user: "wrong authorization"
mutants.original:
require(len(auth) == 1 and q(auth[0]["chainId"]) == 714 and q(auth[0]["nonce"]) == nonce and auth[0]["address"].lower() == target,
                "wrong authorization")

mutants.name: check_user: "authorization did not persist"
mutants.original:
require(before[AUTHORITY]["nonce"] == nonce and after[AUTHORITY]["nonce"] == nonce + 1 and
                normalized(after[AUTHORITY]["code_hash"]) == encoding.keccak256(bytes.fromhex("ef0100" + target[2:])).hex(), "authorization did not persist")

mutants.name: check_user: "authority execution state differs"
mutants.original: require(slot(after, AUTHORITY, "0") == 1, "authority execution state differs")

mutants.name: check_user: "registration hub storage: " + key
mutants.original: require(slot(before, STAKE_HUB, key) == 0 and slot(after, STAKE_HUB, key) == expected, "registration hub storage: " + key)

mutants.name: check_user: "registration credit storage: " + key
mutants.original: require(slot(before, CREDIT, key) == 0 and slot(after, CREDIT, key) == expected, "registration credit storage: " + key)

mutants.name: check_user: "registration governance sync"
mutants.original: require(slot(before, gov, key) == 0 and slot(after, gov, key) == 2000 * 10**18, "registration governance sync")

mutants.name: bootstrap validator jailed
mutants.original: require(slot(state, STAKE_HUB, "validator_jailed") == 0, "bootstrap validator jailed flag")

mutants.name: registration validator jailed
mutants.original: "validator_jailed": 0,

mutants.name: bootstrap validator agent
mutants.original: require(slot(state, STAKE_HUB, "validator_agent") == 0, "bootstrap validator agent")

mutants.name: registration validator agent
mutants.original: "validator_agent": 0,

mutants.name: validator raw word binding
mutants.original:
require(slot(state, STAKE_HUB, "validator_" + label) == slot(state, STAKE_HUB, "validator_word_" + str(offset)),
                "validator label differs from raw word: " + label)
